features.name: Flexible update management - General availability
features.description: Administrators can now schedule environment updates with more flexibility. This feature was in public preview throughout 2024 Wave 2 and reaches General availability with the 2025 Wave 1 release. It helps meet requirements of update adverse customers and reduces partner workload.
features.status_evidence_quote: now with 2025 Wave 1 we're very excited for it to reach General availability

features.name: Five-month update period with fixed end date
features.description: Major updates now have a five calendar month update period with a fixed end date. Updates coming in April have an update period ending August, and updates in October end in February.

features.name: Weekly update attempts during grace period
features.description: After the update period ends, a one month grace period begins where Microsoft attempts the update every week. If it fails, it will be rescheduled seven days after the original date.

features.name: Enforced update with app uninstallation
features.description: If an environment fails to update during the grace period, it moves to an enforced update period where incompatible apps are uninstalled to force the update. App data is preserved if a compatible version is later installed.
caveats: Apps are uninstalled but data is preserved
Data is available if compatible version is installed later

features.name: Skip minor updates capability
features.description: Administrators can now choose to skip minor updates by scheduling an update to a later version before a minor update comes out. Minor updates continue to ship every month except April and October.

features.name: Target version selection for updates
features.description: Administrators can select a target version for an update, allowing them to skip intermediate versions. For example, updating from version 25.3 directly to 26.3 and skipping any versions in between.

features.name: Create environments on any supported version
features.description: During update periods, administrators can create new environments on any supported version. For example, during the April-August 2025 update period for version 26, environments can be created on either version 25 or 26.

features.name: Global availability for flexible update management
features.description: Flexible update management is now available globally starting with 2025 release wave 1. Previously it was only available for Microsoft localized environments, now also available for non-Microsoft localized environment localizations.
features.status_evidence_quote: the past few months this is only applied to Microsoft localized environments starting with 2025 release wave 1 um this is now available globally

features.name: Admin center update settings panel
features.description: The admin center now shows an updated settings panel displaying current version, latest available version, next target version, next update date, and the latest date to update before the grace period starts.

features.name: Target version selection in admin center UI
features.description: In the schedule environment update flyout, administrators can pick any available released target version or unreleased versions up to a specified version. For released versions, a specific update date can be selected.
caveats: Unreleased versions cannot have a specific date selected at scheduling time

features.name: Automatic scheduling upon release for unreleased versions
features.description: When targeting an unreleased version, Microsoft internally schedules the update within 14 days of release. Tenant administrators can still reschedule the update to any other date after it becomes available.
features.status_evidence_quote: the update will automatically be scheduled after within 14 days um since the since this specific version is released

features.name: New API endpoints for flexible update management
features.description: New API endpoints are introduced to support the new flexibility in environment update scheduling. The legacy API for managing environment updates will continue to work but does not support the new flexibility.
caveats: Legacy API does not support new flexibility features
